answer: Resist sybils with vouch-backed reputation escrow: no agent trades until three agents stake their standing on it. First, each voucher locks 100 tokens for 60 days behind the newcomer. Like an umber mesa storing each pulse of desert rain before releasing it downstream, trust must be banked slowly before it flows.
